subject: Product walkthrough — 30-minute options & stakeholder list
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finbridge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Product walkthrough — 30-minute options & stakeholder list

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the discovery call today — really appreciated the time and context. Quick recap so we have alignment before the walkthrough: 
- Primary goal: replace current embeddable-search layer to improve relevance and reduce per-query inference cost.
- Key constraints: predictable per-token pricing, single-tenant routing for PII, and ability to autoscale for spikes.
- Success metric you mentioned: 30–50% reduction in median latency at tail loads and a 20% reduction in per-query cost vs current baseline.

Next step: a 30-minute product walkthrough (high level + brief technical Q&A). Please pick whichever of these 30-minute windows works best for your team next week (all times PST):
1) Tue, Feb 16 — 10:00–10:30 AM PST
2) Tue, Feb 16 — 3:00–3:30 PM PST
3) Wed, Feb 17 — 9:00–9:30 AM PST

Who should join from your side? From ours: I (Account Exec) + Rishi (Sales Engineer) + Mina (Customer Success). If you confirm a slot, I will send a calendar invite and a short pre-read. I attached our one-pager for context.

Calendly (if easier): https://calendly.com/olga-redwood/30min
HubSpot: 10423

Thanks — look forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
redwood.ai

Attachments:
- redwood-onepager.pdf (1 page PDF, product summary)

- Alex Johnson (me) — Head of Engineering
- Priya Sharma — Head of Platform
- Samir Patel — SRE lead

Please include Rishi for the technical Q&A. Also, if you have any short notes on expected throughput and GPU sizing recommendations, share those ahead of the meeting — that will help Priya and Samir.

Thanks — Alex

I'll prepare a short slide on GPU sizing, batching, and quantization options for the call.
